purpose: Compact current-PvME recipe set for bridge, switch and utility perks whose materials are relevant to self-sufficient League planning but do not belong in the primary advanced-armour list.

utility_perk_recipes.layout_note: Do not put Subtle in the middle.
utility_perk_recipes.planner_value: A lower-cost bridge before Biting 4 that makes Subtle a real recipe material without introducing a rare-component gate.

utility_perk_recipes.layout_note: Do not put Healthy in the middle.
utility_perk_recipes.planner_value: Useful poison-immunity bridge recipe; both Direct and Healthy are broad supply materials rather than elective-region gates.
Pure Variable-component utility recipe. This is a component-stock requirement, not a region choice.

utility_perk_recipes.layout_note: Connector must be in the middle in the current PvME layout.
utility_perk_recipes.planner_value: Turns otherwise global Connector/Dextrous supply into a Desert-sensitive recipe because Cywir remains the rare Heart-of-Gielinor bottleneck.
Joins high-level Archaeology Timeworn supply to broadly craftable Precise components. The listed PvME success chance is low, so this is a possible combination rather than a baseline build assumption.
Combines a region-sensitive Shifting route with Fremennik-efficient Explosive and globally sourced Imbued components.

utility_perk_recipes.recipe_result: Virtually guaranteed at 71+ Invention in the current PvME layout.
utility_perk_recipes.planner_value: A Slayer utility combination whose materials are globally craftable; it should not create artificial region pressure.
Current PvME Magic armour recommendation. It is deliberately modeled as a globally supplied Enhancing-component sink rather than a region-specific unlock.

utility_perk_recipes.layout_note: Use the material order shown by the current PvME layout.
utility_perk_recipes.recipe_result: Guaranteed in the current PvME layout.
utility_perk_recipes.planner_value: Useful dual-Slayer combination. Only Dragonfire/Undead carry meaningful region pressure; Base/Living/Enhancing remain broadly sourced.
